formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P8-R1 — Method-Dominance Sensitivity, CFOP-Dependence Decomposition, Cross-Era Method×Reconstructor Stability, Leave-One-Family Transport, Joint-Support Margin Audit & TS-vs-H1 Robustness Separation Stress Test
primary_questions: Is TS positive after deleting every supported method family one at a time?
Which method-family deletions reverse H1, and is CFOP uniquely sign-critical?
How much of each post-stratified TS/H1 mean is compositionally attributable to each method family?
Does the TS-vs-H1 robustness separation persist within temporal eras?
How close are joint method×reconstructor-band TS/H1 results to their adversarial sign-flip thresholds?
readouts: per-method leave-one-out effect and sign for TS/H1
per-method population-weighted contribution to TS/H1 post-stratified mean
era-specific method-cell supported mass, zero-support mass, TS/H1 post-stratified mean and full-range adversarial sign bound
joint-axis adversarial lower bound and margin to sign-flip threshold
reconstructor surface-agreement mismatch count only; no relabeling
adjudication: TS positive under all method deletions and all era-supported post-stratifications => TS composition-robust on observed axes
H1 sign reversal under one or more method deletions => H1 method-composition sensitive even if aggregate population sign remains positive
CFOP-only H1 reversal => CFOP-critical H1 composition dependence
era sign reversals => temporal transport instability
zero-support era/cell mass is never imputed; use full rival-excess range [-1,17/18] for sign bounds
